description: This file defines the SettingsTab class, which is a UI component for managing settings dialogs within the application's configuration interface. It handles UI layout, dialog selection, and interaction with configuration models.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: Represents a UI tab for displaying and modifying configuration settings dialogs. Handles layout, dialog selection, and user interaction.

methods.name: SettingsTab
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SettingsTab and showing a loading message.

methods.name: createPane
methods.description: Returns the main component containing the SettingsTab's UI.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Populates the UI with available dialogs and sets up interactions.

methods.name: selectDialog
methods.description: Loads and displays fields for a selected dialog by name.
